title: Mechanical Technicin
description:
MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN – OIL & GAS

Job Summary
Mechanical Technician responsible for installation, maintenance, inspection, and repair of mechanical and rotating equipment in oil & gas facilities. Ensures safe and efficient operation of pumps, compressors, turbines, valves, and associated systems in compliance with industry standards and site procedures.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on rotating equipment such as pumps, compressors, turbines, gearboxes, and generators
• Carry out installation, dismantling, alignment, and reassembly of mechanical equipment
• Inspect and service industrial valves (gate, globe, ball, control valves) including gasket replacement and leakage rectification
• Conduct equipment troubleshooting and fault diagnosis to minimize downtime
• Execute shutdown and turnaround maintenance activities as per schedule
• Perform precision measurements using tools like vernier caliper, micrometer, dial gauge, and alignment tools
• Maintain and service piping systems, flanges, fittings, and mechanical seals
• Carry out lubrication, oil changes, and condition monitoring of mechanical systems
• Assist in testing, commissioning, and performance verification of equipment
• Follow PTW (Permit to Work), LOTO, and safety procedures strictly
• Maintain proper maintenance records and reporting documentation
• Coordinate with engineers, supervisors, and other trades for smooth execution of work

Key Skills

• Rotating Equipment Maintenance
• Valve Maintenance & Servicing
• Pump & Compressor Handling
• Mechanical Troubleshooting
• Precision Alignment & Measurement
• Shutdown & Turnaround Maintenance
• Piping & Mechanical Systems Knowledge
• Safety Compliance (PTW, LOTO, PPE)
• Workshop & Fabrication Skills



Requirements

Requirements


• Diploma / ITI in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
• Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Oil & Gas / Power Plant / Industrial maintenance
• Hands-on experience with pumps, compressors, turbines, and valves
• Experience in shutdown projects is an advantage
• Valid certifications (if required): H2S, PTW, Confined Space, Working at Height

title: Communication Executive (Hilton Singapore Orchard)
description:
Position Summary

The Call Centre Executive ensures that all communications relating to the hotel both external and internal are actioned efficiently in a professional and courteous manner and in line with Hilton and the hotel policies and procedures during the assigned shift.

What will I be doing?

As the Call Centre Executive, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Actively seeking verbal feedback from customers and team members at every opportunity.

  • Agree on and implement actions to make improvements to customer service.

  • Promote Hilton Honors and its associated benefits to guests who are not already enrolled in the program, ensuring that existing Hilton Honors members receive personal and professional service that recognizes them as important guests and that their benefits are received.

  • Maximize sales and revenue for the hotel by maintaining a sales attitude at all times.

  • Positively deal with and learn from customers’ complaints and comments with follow-up and feedback to the related Communications Manager / Duty Manager.

  • Follow-up with guests to ensure satisfaction with problem resolution (service recovery).

  • Maintain guest history records to assist with returning guests.

  • Make sure all guest requests and queries are responded to promptly and effectively while assisting on the floor during peak periods each day.

  • Be available to assist on duty in the hotels during any busy days or special events.

  • Be proactive towards guests, assist them with any reasonable requests, and train all team members to anticipate guests’ needs.

  • Handle all internal and external guest enquiries promptly with minimal delay, directing them to the correct parties with which they wish to speak to and provide information where necessary.

  • Effectively manage all hotel communications, telephone, fax, mail, in a prompt, courteous and efficient manner, ensuring that guests feel welcome when they contact the hotel.

  • Be up to date with information on facilities, attractions, places of interests, sights and activities in and around the hotel.

  • Handle and deliver all messages in a private and confidential manner, ensuring privacy for guests and ensure that the messages are received and delivered clearly, accurately and in a timely manner.

  • Ensure that we provide on time wake-up call services for hotel guests.

  • Knowledgeable of Hilton’s departmental standards and run the Telecommunication Centre as a Communications Centre according to brand standards, explaining standards to the team, assess their performance against these standards and monitor standards through regular standards review checks.

  • Familiar with hotel operating system especially OnQ PM, Kipsu, HotSOS, PBX, table management system and Micros system.

  • Take on an active role in the team by being kind, cooperative, and helpful and never forgetting the person behind the guest.

  • Record all equipment and be familiar with the system and functions, resuming the role as the person in charge of the section during the absence of the Communications Manager.

  • Describe, assign and delegate duties and authorities for the operation of the department at all times.

  • Knowledgeable of hotel and departmental KPIs especially SALT and Hilton Honors enrolment. Assisting Communications Manager to drive result to the maximum.

  • Plan and coordinate with the team, ensure adequate resources are available.

  • Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure request is followed-up and ensures follow-up procedures are maintained.

  • Communicate effectively with the F&B and Culinary teams to ensure in-room dining quality is as per hotel standard.

  • Be completely familiar with all emergency procedures and the fire system, ensuring that all Communications team members are familiar with the procedures too.

  • Ensure handovers information to the next shift.

  • Maintain in-depth technical knowledge and skills required for the job.

  • Maintain guest histories to assist with returning guests.

  • Attend and participate in regular operational and hotel meetings.

  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as requested by the Communications Manager.

  • Understand the goals of the hotel and the department’s role in achieving them, communicating the goals to the team.

  • Understand departmental objectives for self and team, and work together to achieve the goal accordingly.

  • Keep the team up to date about departmental, hotel and company activities through regular communication meetings and memos including special events and promotions in the restaurants and bars.

  • Be aware of potential highs and lows in the business.

  • Complete regular financial and operating reports, as required or requested by the Communications Manager.

  • Follow company control procedures, controlling costs without compromising standards.

  • Keep self up to date and Introduce appropriate product knowledge courses to the team.

  • Understand relevant Health & Safety legislations and their implications on the department’s operation.

  • Communicate to the team their responsibilities within Health & Safety, ensuring that safe and healthy working practices are implemented at all times.

  • Maintain personal presentation to hotel and Hilton standards.

  • Ensure that all reporting and servicing deadlines are met on a timely basis.

  • Adhere to the hotel’s security and emergency policies and procedures.

What are we looking for?

A Call Centre Executive serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Minimum 1 years of experience in the same position in a 5-star international branded hotel or comparable industry related experience.

  • Maintain a high customer service focus by approaching your job with the customers always in mind.

  • Positively impact, take personal responsibility and initiative to resolve issues, communicating clearly with both customers and colleagues.

  • Motivated and committed, approaching all tasks with enthusiasm and seizing opportunities to learn new skills or knowledge in order to improve personal performance.

  • Maintain high team focus by showing co-operation and support to colleagues in the pursuit of team goals.

  • Contribute ideas and suggestions to enhance operational / environmental procedures in the hotel.

  • Good organization and coordination skills.

  • Strong sense of responsibility and self-motivation.

  • Patient and responsible to solve all problems.

  • Able to work under great physical and mental pressure.

  • Actively promote the services and facilities of Hilton brands to guests and suppliers of the hotel.

  • Perform all duties and responsibilities in a manner that ensures your safety and that of others in your workplace.

What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travellers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

description:
1. Tele-control / SCADA Technician (Water Control System)

Job Description (JD)

  • Install, wire, and test PLC panels and Remote Terminal Units (RTUs) at water facilities.

  • Perform routine and emergency troubleshooting of field devices, including flow meters, pressure transmitters, and water quality analyzers.

  • Assist engineers during Factory Acceptance Tests and Site Acceptance Tests.

  • Maintain detailed records of work logs and maintenance reports.


2. Tele-control / Substation Control System (SCS) Technician

  • Responsible for the routine maintenance of National Control Center (NCC) and Distribution Control Center (DCC) RTUs.

The bill requires the Agency for Health Care Administration (AHCA), in consultation with all specified agencies, to develop and maintain a user-friendly, public-facing webpage to serve as a centralized hub for education and awareness of the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse and state background screening processes and standards. title: Security Guards
description:
We are seeking a vigilant and physically fit Security Guard to protect personnel, assets, and infrastructure at our oil and gas facility (onshore/offshore). The ideal candidate will have experience in industrial security, access control, and emergency response. You will be the first line of defense against unauthorized access, theft, vandalism, and potential security threats in a remote or sensitive environment.

Key Responsibilities
1. Access Control & Perimeter Security

Control entry and exit points for personnel, vehicles, and contractors at facility gates, helipads, or marine terminals.

Verify identification, permits, and vehicle manifests against entry logs.

Conduct patrols of facility perimeters, pipelines, storage areas, and restricted zones to detect breaches, leaks, or suspicious activity.

Monitor CCTV cameras, alarm systems, and radio communications continuously.

2. Asset Protection & Anti-Theft

Prevent theft of company assets, tools, and consumables (a significant issue in remote camps).

Inspect outgoing vehicles and personnel baggage (where permitted by policy) to prevent unauthorized removal of property.

Secure "Red Zones" and high-security areas (e.g., control rooms, wellheads, explosive storage).

3. Emergency Response & Safety

Serve as a first responder during emergencies (fires, H2S releases, medical evacuations) until specialized teams arrive.

Conduct regular headcounts during evacuations or emergency drills.

Enforce safety rules, such as ensuring personnel wear correct PPE before entering operational areas.

Report security incidents, near misses, and safety hazards immediately via formal reports.

4. Surveillance & Reporting

Maintain a detailed security logbook documenting shift activities, incidents, and visitor logs.

Write clear and concise incident reports.

Communicate shift handovers effectively to incoming guards, highlighting any ongoing issues.

5. Crowd & Traffic Management

Manage traffic flow at facility gates and parking areas.

Control crowds during crew changes, catering deliveries, or site events.

description:
The Food & Beverage Executive is concerned with the efficient and professional service of food and beverages within the restaurant, ensuring that the restaurant returns a budgeted profit through tight cost and stock control. This role directly supervises team members while ensuring that all guests receive optimum service in accordance with the standards, policies and procedures of Hilton.

What will I be doing?

As the Food & Beverage Executive, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Maintain a high customer service focus by approaching your job with the guests always in mind.

  • Have a positive impact, taking personal responsibility and initiative to resolve issues, always clearly communicating with both guests and colleagues.

  • Contribute ideas and suggestions to enhance operational/ environmental procedures in the hotel.

  • Actively promote the services and facilities of Hilton hotels to guests and suppliers of the hotel.

  • Perform all duties and responsibilities in a manner that ensures your safety and that of others in your workplace.

  • Confidently know the food and beverage menu contents and explain them in detail to guests.

  • Understand dietary requirements and offer appropriate suggestions.

  • In consultation with the Manager, agree and implement actions to make improvements to customer service.

  • Complete the checklist in product knowledge.

  • Make suggestions on the menu that might suit guests of different nationalities.

  • Familiarize with menu items of all other outlets to recommend guests to other outlets.

  • Confidently know the opening hours of all restaurants and hotel outlets.

  • Able to recommend other restaurants and city attractions to hotel guests.

  • Actively check team members’ product knowledge on each shift.

  • Undertake steps/ processes to ensure that all areas of the restaurant are set to the standards required for breakfast, lunch and dinner, including the checking of the cashier desk set-up and communicating with the Chefs on any details for the shift and number of reservations for the day.

  • Check reservations for the day, ensuring that the restaurant and team members have tables ready and large bookings have been confirmed by phone.

  • Assist bartenders and kitchen team members where required and carry out any reasonable duties requested by the Manager.

  • Ensure that all team members are briefed for the details of the shift ahead.

  • Complete the checklist on preparing the restaurant for service.

  • Greet guests with a smile, offer assistance and introduce yourself.

  • Follow-up on any guest questions or queries immediately and if you don’t have the answer, check with your Manager.

  • Ensure that all service procedures are carried out to the standards required.

  • Make sure that all areas are cleaned and maintained in accordance with operating procedure.

  • Supervise the restaurant roster on a daily basis and ensure it is in line with the changing business levels, making any changes in order to achieve the F&B team service standards and budget goals.

  • Control the allocated labour for each shift to ensure that guest expectations are met whilst achieving the desired labour cost.

  • Assist restaurant managers with training all team members for the ‘induction training’ and ‘on the job training’.

  • Offer team members constructive feedback about their performance after every shift in an aim to develop their skills and confidence.

  • Provide leadership and direction for all team members while on duty by offering professional skills and leading by example.

  • Ensure that the shift is reviewed, handovers and briefings are carried out.

  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.

What are we looking for?

An Food & Beverage Executive serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • 2-4 years in supervisory position in a 4/ 5-star category hotel.

  • Good English skills, both verbal and written to meet business needs.

  • Motivated and committed, approaching all tasks with enthusiasm and seize opportunities to learn new skills or knowledge in order to improve personal performance.

  • Flexible and responds quickly and positively to changing requirements including the performance of any tasks requested of you.

  • Maintain high team focus by showing cooperation and support to colleagues in the pursuit of team goals.

  • Strong leadership and training skills.

  • Outgoing personality and willing to work for long hours.

What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travelers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

title: General Technician
description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Maintenance & Repair

Perform routine preventive maintenance on rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, generators, turbines) and stationary equipment (valves, pipelines, pressure vessels).

Diagnose mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic system failures and execute corrective actions.

Assist in the overhaul and installation of new machinery and components.

Conduct inspections to detect issues such as leaks, corrosion, or unusual wear patterns.

2. Operational Support

Monitor control panels, gauges, and instruments to ensure equipment is operating within specified parameters.

Support drilling and workover operations by maintaining deck machinery and rig equipment.

Isolate equipment (Lock-Out/Tag-Out) for maintenance and assist in recommissioning after repairs.

3. Safety & Compliance

Strictly adhere to Permit to Work (PTW) systems and safety protocols.

Participate in Toolbox Talks, safety meetings, and emergency response drills.

Ensure the work area is maintained in a clean and hazard-free condition (Housekeeping).

Report near misses, unsafe conditions, and environmental incidents immediately.

4. Documentation

Accurately complete maintenance logs, work orders, and inspection reports.

Track spare parts usage and assist in inventory management.

Qualifications & Requirements
Education & Certification

High School Diploma or equivalent (Technical/Vocational diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering is highly preferred).

Valid certifications in relevant safety standards (e.g., BOSIET, OGUK, or H2S awareness) depending on location.

Trade certification (e.g., Millwright, Fitter, Electrician) is a strong advantage.

Experience

2–5 years of experience in a maintenance role, preferably within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, or Heavy Industrial sectors.

Experience working in remote or offshore environments is a plus.

Technical Skills

Proficiency in reading Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) and technical manuals.

Working knowledge of hand and power tools, precision measuring instruments, and diagnostic equipment.

Basic understanding of electrical systems, hydraulics, and diesel engines.

title: NDT Technician / Inspector and Assistance QC Inspector
description:
We are looking for a NDT Technician / Inspector and Assistant QC Inspector who will be responsible for supporting inspection, testing, and quality control activities during the repair and refurbishment of rotating equipment and turbo machinery. The role ensures components meet applicable standards, client specifications, and quality requirements throughout dismantling, inspection, repair, and final assembly stages.


Key Responsibilities

A. NDT Inspection Duties

  • Perform Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods including:
    • Visual Testing (VT)
    • Liquid Penetrant Testing (PT)
    • Magnetic Particle Testing (MT)
    • Ultrasonic Testing (UT)
  • Inspect critical components such as:
    • Turbine rotors, shafts, blades, casings
    • Compressors, pumps, impellers, seals, bearings
  • Detect and evaluate defects such as cracks, corrosion, erosion, and fatigue damage.

B. QC Inspection Support

  • Assist QC Inspectors/Engineers in:
    • Incoming material inspection
    • In-process inspection during refurbishment
    • Final inspection prior to dispatch
  • Verify dimensions, tolerances, and clearances as per drawings and specifications.
  • Ensure inspection hold points and quality plans (ITP) are followed.

C. Documentation & Reporting

  • Prepare and maintain:
    • NDT reports
    • Inspection checklists and formats
    • Calibration and equipment logs
  • Record inspection findings with proper defect evaluation and acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain traceability of components and inspection records.

D. Standards & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with:
    • ASME, API, ISO, ASTM standards
    • Client specifications and internal QA/QC procedures
  • Follow company safety rules and quality management system (QMS).

E. Equipment & Tools

  • Operate and maintain NDT inspection equipment.
  • Ensure proper calibration and certification of measuring instruments.
  • Use precision tools such as:
    • Micrometers
    • Vernier calipers
    • Dial gauges

F. Coordination

  • Work closely with:
    • QA/QC Engineers
    • Workshop/Production teams
    • Mechanical and repair engineers
  • Support client inspections, audits, and third-party inspections.


Requirements

Education

  • Diploma / ITI / Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent technical field.

Certifications

  • NDT Certification (Level II ) as per:
    • ASNT / PCN / ISO 9712

Experience

  • NDT Technician / Inspector:
    Minimum 3–5 years of experience in NDT for rotating machinery or turbomachinery.
  • Assistant QC Inspector:
    Minimum 3–5 years of experience in QC/inspection in mechanical or repair workshops.

Skills & Competencies

  • Knowledge of rotating equipment and turbomachinery components.
  • Understanding of inspection codes and standards.
  • Ability to read engineering drawings and technical documents.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and report-writing ability.

title: System Integrator Expert
description:
Job Title: System Integrator Expert

Engagement Type: Consultant – Project Management & Consulting (PMC) and Technical Support
Project Phase: Phase 3 – Implementation, PMC, and Technical Support
Reporting To: Project Director / Client Representative

Job Summary

The System Integrator Expert will provide expert consulting, project management, and technical support services during Phase 3 of the project. The role is responsible for overseeing system implementation, ensuring adherence to approved project plans, timelines, and quality standards, and supporting the client through to successful project completion and issuance of the Final Acceptance Certificate (FAC).

The consultant will act as a key interface between stakeholders, system vendors, and delivery teams, ensuring smooth coordination, issue resolution, and compliance with contractual and technical requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Oversight

  • Monitor and oversee the progress of the Designated System Integrator (DSI) to ensure compliance with the approved project plan, scope, schedule, and milestones.

  • Ensure project activities are executed in accordance with contractual obligations, industry best practices, and agreed standards.

  • Support the client in tracking progress, risks, dependencies, and corrective actions throughout the implementation phase.

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Facilitate effective communication and coordination among all internal and external stakeholders, including client teams, system integrators, vendors, and third parties.

  • Conduct and participate in regular project meetings, reviews, and technical workshops as required.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the client on system integration–related matters.

Technical Leadership & Support

  • Provide technical guidance and expert oversight across specialized system integration domains as required during implementation.

  • Identify, analyze, and resolve technical or operational challenges to keep the project on track.

  • Review technical documents, designs, integration plans, test results, and implementation deliverables for compliance and quality.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Ensure that all deliverables meet the required technical, operational, and quality standards.

  • Support the verification and validation of systems prior to completion and handover.

  • Assist in ensuring readiness for audits, inspections, and acceptance processes.

Project Completion & Acceptance

  • Provide continuous guidance and oversight until successful project completion.

  • Support the client through commissioning, testing, and final handover activities.

  • Assist in the preparation and validation of documentation required for issuance of the Completion Certificate / Final Acceptance Certificate (FAC).

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.

  • Master’s degree or professional certifications in Project Management or System Integration is an advantage.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in system integration, large-scale infrastructure or technology projects.

  • Proven experience in Project Management & Consulting (PMC) roles during implementation phases.

  • Strong background in overseeing system integrators, vendors, and multi-disciplinary teams.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting projects through commissioning and Final Acceptance Certificate (FAC) stages.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong expertise in system integration methodologies and implementation best practices.

  • Excellent project management, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Ability to provide hands-on technical guidance across specialized domains when required.

  • Excellent communication, reporting, and documentation skills.

  • Ability to work under tight timelines and manage complex, high-priority projects.

Deliverables

  • Regular progress monitoring and reporting to the client.

  • Technical reviews, recommendations, and issue-resolution support.

  • Assurance of compliance with project scope, standards, and milestones.

  • Support through project completion and successful issuance of the Final Acceptance Certificate (FAC).

title: Front Office Executive (Hilton Singapore Orchard)
description:
Position Statement

The Front Office Executive greets and registers guests, providing prompt and courteous service. He/ she checks guests in and out, resolving guest challenges throughout their stay in our hotel during the assigned shift. This role upgrades guests as required and promotes the hotel’s services. We are looking for Front Office Executive for the following sections: Front Desk, Executive Lounge

What will I be doing?

As the Front Office Executive, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Complete the registration process by inputting and retrieving information from a computer system, confirming relevant information including number of guests and room rates.

  • Understand departmental objectives for self and team, and work together to achieve the goal accordingly.

  • Promote Hilton Honours and its associated benefits to guests who are not already enrolled in the program, ensuring that existing Hilton Honours members receive personal and professional service that recognizes them as important guests and that their benefits are received.

  • Ensures guests know the location of rooms containing room keys, tokens of our appreciation, gifts, etc., to guests.

  • Ensure rooms and services are correctly accounted for within guests’ statements, properly stating services provided by the hotel.

  • Assist guests with payments or charges, accepting and recording vouchers, credits, traveller’s checks and other forms of payment.

  • Greet guests with a friendly and sincere welcome in a positive and clear speaking voice, listen and understand requests, respond with appropriate actions and provide accurate information such on outlet hours, special VIP programs, events, etc.

  • Receive special requests from guests and respond appropriately or forward requests to appropriate team members for their decisions and actions.

  • Promptly answer the telephone and email inquiries, inputting messages into the computer and advising other team members of special guests’ needs.

  • Retrieve messages and communicate the content to guests, retrieving mail, packages and facsimiles or other special items for guests as requested.

  • Record guests’ complaints, conducting thorough research to develop the most effective solution and negotiate results.

  • Listen and extend assistance in order to resolve problems raised by guests.

  • Remain calm and alert especially during emergency situations and heavy hotel activity.

  • Plan and implement detailed steps by using experienced judgment and discretion.

  • Actively take part in training where and when required, attending formal training sessions and on the job trainings to ensure standards and develop skills and abilities.

  • Contribute to the hotel and team by sharing new ideas and suggestions for improvements, being innovative and creative to provide quality service to team members and guests.

  • Take on an active role in the Executive Lounge team, ensuring effective communication and working as a team in order to reach goals and targets.

  • Create a warm and welcoming arrival for guests, ensuring that they feel welcome and “at-home” upon arrival.

  • Check-in guests in accordance with their reservation details, ensuring that the registration cards are completed, reservation information confirmed, Hilton Honours and Frequent Flyer numbers enquired about, and method of payment is secured.

  • Handle complaints promptly and efficiently, taking the necessary action, and informing the Duty Manager/ Assistant Manager, Front Office to follow-up where appropriate including all operational issues.

  • Follow-up with all guests to ensure satisfaction with problem resolution.

  • Maintain awareness of guests’ profile and specific preferences, ensuring that they are acted upon for each reservation.

  • Ensure that VIP guests are treated personally and recognized as an individual.

  • Liaise with Sales, Reservations and the Business Development teams to handle corporate guests.

  • Ensure a prompt and efficient departure, by settling guests’ accounts as per billing and reservation instructions, ensuring that all guests’ folios are correct.

  • Input information into hotel operating system regarding guests, ensuring accuracy and that all details are completed, and the information can be clearly understood by other team members.

  • Apply Hilton brand standards in each and every action, acting as a role model and example of how the standards should be carried out in a practical setting.

  • Knowledgeable of the hotel’s facilities and services as well as basic knowledge of Hilton brand.

  • Keeping up to date with information on facilities, attractions, and places of interests, sightseeing and activities in and around the hotel.

  • Effectively communicate, coordinate and cooperate with Housekeeping, F&B, Engineering, and other relevant departments.

  • Report problems with hotel systems, hardware or facilities to the appropriate parties and follow-up to ensure that corrective action has been taken.

  • Pass on information effectively, ensuring that all necessary details are communicated to the intended person and that any pending action is completed, and guest satisfaction is confirmed.

  • Attend daily briefings, shift handovers, meetings and read the logbook on a daily basis.

  • Ensure that the day-to-day functions of the front desk are completed, including but not limited to checklists, trace reports, credit limit checks, and online back-ups.

  • Check registration cards, meetings and functions information, billing instructions, and reservation backup to ensure that all information received is acted upon accordingly.

  • Ensure that the front desk stock is managed and not wasted, maintaining costs where applicable.

  • Keep up to date and aware of competitor activities in order to be well informed.

  • Adhere to the hotel selling strategy of Demand Based Pricing and maintain rate integrity by offering clear, transparent, and value for money rates to guests.

  • Comply with Health & Safety, Emergency Management, the Disaster manual, Fire procedures and regulations, taking part in the fire team when and where directed.

  • Adhere strictly to standard cash handling procedures, ensuring to balance float and drop the required amount, managing cash, credit card transactions, city ledgers, vouchers and all other forms of payment correctly.

  • Adhere to the company’s credit policy at all times when handling cash, credit card transactions, city ledgers, LPO and third party payments for rooms, meetings, F&B and any other charges that may be incurred by guests.

  • Maintain the efficiency of departure by checking all guests’ folios to ensure accuracy of charges.

  • Upsell rooms to higher room and rate categories, ensuring maximum revenue generation from each guest.

  • Maintain awareness of sales opportunities within the hotel, maximizing revenue in an ethical and responsible manner, adhering to Hilton brand standards and ensuring that guests receive value for money.

  • Attempt to communicate with guests in guests’ native language, if necessary.

  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.

What are we looking for?

A Front Office Executive serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Able to perform moderately complex mathematical calculations without error.

  • Able to access and accurately input information using a moderately complex computer system.

  • Able to effectively deal with internal and external guests, some of whom will require high levels of patience, tact and diplomacy to defuse anger, collect accurate information and resolve conflicts.

  • Good interpersonal skills to provide overall guest satisfaction.

  • Able to work under pressure and deal with stressful situations during busy periods.

  • 1 or 2 years of related working experience preferred.

What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travellers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

title: Security Executive (Hilton Singapore Orchard)
description:
Position Summary

The Security Executive is responsible for the duties and activities of Security Officers during a shift. The role should ensure that positions, procedures, patrols and their frequencies are established and adhered to.

What will I be doing?

As the Security Executive, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Supervise each security operation shift, making sure adequate patrol patterns and frequencies are maintained to ensure the security of guests and team members.

  • Familiarize with and check hotel fire equipment and fire evacuation passages.

  • Ensure Security Officer report any safety, security and defects issues to the respective department promptly as recorded during their patrols.

  • Familiarize with each department’s work procedures, security knowledge and emergency procedures, supervising each position’s professional knowledge and work standards.

  • Conduct random bag inspections of team members entering and leaving the building.

  • Ensure asset removal policy is adhered to, to prevent hotel assets from being removed without proper authorization.

  • Arrange approved routes and escort services for team members carrying cash, where required.

  • Ensure perimeter patrols are carried out once every 3 shifts by Security Officers and maintain records.

  • Professionally examine team members’ work knowledge, discipline and responsibilities.

  • Responsible for team members’ daily shift work schedule and attendance record.

  • Convey and carry out the department’s work arrangements and training plans.

  • Conduct random inspections of the hotel to ensure security practices are being followed, fire exits are not blocked, and equipment is not obstructing fire hose reel doors, sufficient clearance between stacked goods and sprinkler heads.

  • Follow up with contractors and vendors on rectifying all fire safety and critical systems.

  • Take appropriate action to resolve guests’ complaints, communicating professionally and effectively with guests.

  • Be familiar with current first aid and fire emergency procedures.

  • Maintain all Safety & Security Audit daily, weekly, monthly and annual documentations.

  • Ensure a high level of cleanliness and tidiness in your work area.

  • Maintain a professional appearance up to Hilton standards, demonstrating good attitude and behaviour at all times.

  • Interact with team members in a professional and positive manner to foster good rapport, promote team spirit and ensure effective two-way communication.

  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.

What are we looking for?

A Security Executive serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • At least 2 years of experience in a supervisory position.

  • Holds a valid Security Officer License by Police Licensing and Regulatory Department (PLRD).

  • Able to communicate effectively and clearly.

  • Good knowledge of the hotel’s life-safety systems, fire equipment and security operations.

  • Excellent leadership skills.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and attention to details.

  • Literacy in English to meet business needs, preferred.

  • Trained first aider and Company Emergency Response Team (CERT) certification preferred.

What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travellers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

title: Club Lounge Executive (Hilton Singapore Orchard)
description:
Position Statement

The Club Lounge Executive is to provide professional service with warm hospitality to our guests by delivering consistent quality service to all guests at all-time and ensuring their lounge visit will become a memorable experience. He / she ensures guest requests are fulfilled, maintains high levels of guest satisfaction and resolving guest challenges throughout their stay in our hotel during the assigned shift.


What will you be doing?

As the Club Lounge Executive, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Understand departmental objectives for self and team, and work together to achieve the goal accordingly.

  • Welcome every guest with a genuine, warm, and personalized greeting with a positive and clear speaking voice, listen and understand requests, respond with appropriate actions and provide accurate information such on outlet hours, special VIP programs, events, etc

  • Address guests by name and recognize repeat / VIP guests and treated personally and recognized as an individual with their preferences

  • Demonstrate strong emotional intelligence by read guest cues and adapt service style accordingly

  • Build natural rapport through friendly conversation and attentive presence

  • Promote Hilton Honours and its associated benefits to guests who are not already enrolled in the program, ensuring that existing Hilton

  • Honours members receive personal and professional service that recognizes them as important guests and that their benefits are received.

  • Responsible for maintaining hygiene and cleanliness standards in the Executive Lounge and upkeep of all service equipment.

  • Responsible for all service / buffet preparations before, during and after the service (mis-en-place).

  • Serve / Refills beverages with grace, confidence, and attention to detail.

  • Proper handling of equipment throughout the department.

  • Ensure compliance with F&B audit requirements.

  • Thorough menu and F&B product knowledge.

  • Receive special requests from guests and respond appropriately or forward requests to appropriate team members for their decisions and actions.

  • Record guests’ complaints, conducting thorough research to develop the most effective solution and negotiate results.

  • Listen and extend assistance in order to resolve problems raised by guests

  • Remain calm and alert especially during emergency situations and heavy hotel activity.

  • Plan and implement detailed steps by using experienced judgment and discretion.

  • Actively take part in training where and when required, attending formal training sessions and on the job trainings to ensure standards and develop skills and abilities.

  • Contribute to the hotel and team by sharing new ideas and suggestions for improvements, being innovative and creative to provide quality service to team members and guests.

  • Handle complaints promptly and efficiently, taking the necessary action, and informing the Assistant Executive Floor Manager or Executive

  • Floor Manager to follow-up where appropriate including all operational issues.

  • Maintain awareness of guests’ profile & specific preferences, ensuring that they are acted.

  • Apply Hilton value in each and every action, acting as a role model and example of how the standards should be carried out in a practical setting.

  • Knowledgeable of the hotel’s facilities and services as well as basic knowledge of Hilton International

  • Keeping up to date with information on facilities, attractions, and places of interests, sightseeing and activities in and around the hotel.

  • Effectively communicate, coordinate and cooperate with Housekeeping, F&B, Engineering, and other relevant departments.

  • Report problems with hotel systems, hardware or facilities to the appropriate parties and follow-up to ensure that corrective action has been taken.

  • Pass on information effectively, ensuring that all necessary details are communicated to the intended person and that any pending action is completed, and guest satisfaction is confirmed.

  • Attend daily briefings, shift handovers, meetings and read the logbook on a daily basis.

  • Ensure that the front desk stock is managed and not wasted, maintaining costs where applicable.

  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.

What are we looking for?

A Club Lounge Executive serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Able to perform moderately complex mathematical calculations without error.

  • Able to access and accurately input information using a moderately complex computer system.

  • Able to effectively deal with internal and external guests, some of whom will require high levels of patience, tact and diplomacy to defuse anger, collect accurate information and resolve conflicts.

  • Good interpersonal skills to provide overall guest satisfaction.

  • Able to work under pressure and deal with stressful situations during busy periods.

  • 1 or 2 years of related working experience preferred.

What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travellers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

title: Food and Beverage Supervisor
description:

title: Chief Engineer
description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for the entire engineering operations of all the hotel’s systems, plant, and equipment. You ensure the POMEC budget is utilised as efficiently and effectively as possible to satisfy guest needs, the property, and its assets. As a Chief Engineer,you’re not just assisting the Director in overseeing the safety and functionality of the property – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Partner in leading facility operations: Assist in directing the functionality, safety, and compliance of buildings, mechanical systems, electrical systems, HVAC, life safety systems, and grounds in accordance with federal, state, and local regulations
  • Oversee facility maintenance: Perform facility inspections and supervise construction, installation, maintenance, and repairs of electrical, mechanical, and architectural systems
  • Support property improvement projects: Assist in directing capital projects and property rehabilitations – including scheduling, budgeting, contractor bidding, and licensing/permitting – while ensuring regulatory compliance
  • Oversee work order fulfillment: Ensure routine maintenance and repairs are assigned, verified, and documented in the property maintenance management system
  • Ensure regulatory compliance: Communicate with government officials to maintain permits, coordinate inspections, and uphold safety and code standards
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs
  • Communication & Collaboration: Ensure professional, efficient, and thorough communication between Engineering and all other hotel areas, fostering positive interactions at both individual and department levels.
  • Customer Service Focus: Maintain a high customer service focus, respecting guest privacy and ensuring their comfort and confidentiality.
  • Sustainability & Efficiency: Manage the Lightstay Corporate Responsibility platform, drive sustainability projects, and monitor asset efficiencies on the building automation system.

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:

  • Engineering degree or relevant certification
  • 10+ years in hotel/building services or related field, 5+ years as Chief/Assistant Chief Engineer in a 5-star hotel
  • Strong engineering background with trade expertise, trade-qualified in Electrical, Mechanical, or Plumbing/Gas Fitting
  • Adapt to a flexible schedule; available 24/7 for emergencies
  • Specialized knowledge in HVAC, water treatment, hydraulics, chillers, electronics, lighting, elevators, fire safety, and related systems
  • Skilled in maintaining all hotel building services (e.g., security, A/C, plumbing, electrical, kitchen, laundry, lifts, TV/sound systems)
  • Familiar with government regulations and technical standards

description:

The Food & Beverage Executive is responsible for delivering elevated, intuitive and engaging dining experiences across all outlets, including restaurants, bars, in-room dining and events.

This role goes beyond service execution, taking ownership of service flow, guest engagement and operational coordination. The Food & Beverage Executive supports supervisors and managers in ensuring seamless operations, maintaining high standards and driving guest satisfaction while contributing to team performance and development.

GENERAL DUTIES

• Take ownership of service sections, ensuring smooth and efficient operations.

• Coordinate with kitchen and bar teams to ensure timely and accurate service delivery.

• Support daily outlet operations across restaurant, bar, banquets and in-room dining.

• Maintain a clean, organised and well-prepared service environment.

• Undertake any other duties or tasks deemed reasonable by the Restaurant Manager or Supervisor.

• Handle cash, credit card transactions and settlements responsibly.

• Maintain outlet cleanliness, organisation and equipment standards.

• Stay updated on menu changes, promotions and seasonal offerings.

• Support and guide team members during service to maintain standards.

• Assist in training junior team members and reinforcing service techniques.

• Ensure service procedures are executed correctly and consistently.

• Create memorable and engaging dining experiences aligned with NoMad standards.

• Build rapport with guests and anticipate their needs proactively.

• Provide informed recommendations on menu items, beverages and pairings.

• Handle guest feedback, complaints and service recovery professionally.

• Ensure consistency and excellence in every guest interaction.

TEAMWORK & DEVELOPMENT

• Support supervisors in leading the team during service periods.

• Act as a role model for service excellence and professionalism.

• Participate actively in training and development programs.

• Contribute ideas for improving service quality and guest experience.

• Foster teamwork, collaboration and a positive work environment.

COMPLIANCE & SAFETY

• Adhere to hygiene, food safety and sanitation standards at all times.

• Ensure responsible service of alcohol in accordance with regulations.

• Maintain high standards of personal grooming and presentation.

• Follow all health, safety and company policies and procedures.

• Ensure a safe and compliant working environment.

EXPECTATIONS:

The F&B Executive is expected to:

• Always maintain a consistently professional and polished demeanor.

• Represent NoMad positively in all guest and team interactions.

• Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability during service.

• Exhibit attention to detail and operational awareness.

• Foster teamwork and effective communication.

• Show initiative, adaptability and a proactive mindset.

• Champion company values and deliver exceptional hospitality.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum 1–3 years of experience in Food & Beverage operations, preferably in a luxury or lifestyle environment.

• Strong knowledge of food service, beverages and dining operations.

• Good communication and interpersonal skills.

• Experience with POS and electronic ordering systems.

• Knowledge of food hygiene and safety standards.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

• Positive attitude, leadership potential and willingness to learn.

• Flexibility to work shifts, weekends and public holidays.

title: Application Specialist – Healthcare Insurance Systems (Billing)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of RCM, Billing, and Insurance systems to ensure compliance operational requirements.
  • Support billing rules setup, corporate accounts, exemptions, markups, and pre-authorization workflows as per health insurance standards.
  • Provide support for claims lifecycle processes, including eligibility checks, pre-authorizations, billing, coding, claim submissions, and remittance processing.
  • Support the integration of insurance data with internal EMR and financial systems, with a focus on Cerner workflows.
  • Collaborate with Finance and Insurance teams to document business requirements and assist in translating them into system workflows.
  • Prepare and execute test cases for System Testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Unit Testing (UT), and Functional Testing (FT), focusing on system functionality and compliance.
  • Provide end-user training and support, including the development of training materials for system functionalities related to insurance workflows.
  • Assist in data migration tasks, including preparing data migration templates and data collection worksheets to ensure seamless system transitions.

  • Participate in system upgrades, patches, and testing cycles to ensure optimal system performance.
  • Prepare functional documentation, including SOW, workflows, and best practice.
  • Provide on-site and remote support during go-live and post-go-live phases to ensure operational stability.
  • Willingness to work in shifts to support critical project and operational needs

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, Business Administration or a related field.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Visio for process documentation and workflow design.
Skills:
  • Strong understanding of billing and insurance workflows, including Fee for Service, DRG (Diagnosis-Related Groups), and insurance agreements.

  • Understanding of HL7 messaging formats and ability to validate insurance-related transactions.

title: Permit to Work (PTW) Coordinator - Offshore
description:
The PTW Coordinator is responsible for managing and controlling the Permit to Work system to ensure all maintenance, construction, and operational activities are performed safely and in compliance with company procedures and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

· Coordinate the issuance, monitoring, suspension, and closure of work permits.

· Verify that all work activities are properly risk assessed and authorized.

· Ensure compliance with Permit to Work, Isolation, SIMOPS, and HSE procedures.

· Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance, and Contractor personnel regarding permit requirements.

· Review Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Method Statements, and risk assessments.

· Maintain PTW records and reports.

· Conduct permit audits and participate in safety inspections.

· Support shutdowns, turnarounds, and major maintenance campaigns.



Requirements

· Diploma, Higher National Diploma (HND), Associate Degree, or equivalent technical qualification.

· Minimum 10 years of experience in oil and gas operations, production, or maintenance environments.

· Minimum 6 years of experience working with production operations and control systems.

· Experience with Distributed Control Systems (DCS), SCADA, or Oil & Gas Control Command Systems.

· Strong knowledge of PTW, isolation management, lockout/tagout (LOTO), and SIMOPS.

· NEBOSH, IOSH, H2S, and PTW certifications preferred.

· Excellent coordination and communication skills.

Summary of HB 531

The bill requires the Agency for Health Care Administration (AHCA), in consultation with all specified agencies, to develop and maintain a user-friendly, public-facing webpage to serve as a centralized hub for education and awareness of the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse and state background screening processes and standards. The webpage must maintain up to date information and explain the background screening process through the clearinghouse, Level 2 screening requirements, fingerprinting procedures, and include a searchable job catalog, disqualifying offenses, exemption steps, and a downloadable checklist with timelines and details of the process.

Additionally, the bill requires all specified agencies to prominently link to this resource from their websites and require the inclusion of the link in all job postings by qualified entities

Summary of HB 531

The bill requires the Agency for Health Care Administration (AHCA), in consultation with all specified agencies, to develop and maintain a user-friendly, public-facing webpage to serve as a centralized hub for education and awareness of the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse and state background screening processes and standards. The webpage must maintain up to date information and explain the background screening process through the clearinghouse, Level 2 screening requirements, fingerprinting procedures, and include a searchable job catalog, disqualifying offenses, exemption steps, and a downloadable checklist with timelines and details of the process.

Additionally, the bill requires all specified agencies to prominently link to this resource from their websites and require the inclusion of the link in all job postings by qualified entities

title: Development Analyst
description:

At Sunrise Senior Living, we believe meaningful work starts with purpose. Our team members are passionate about making a positive difference in the lives of residents every day.

As a part of the Sunrise team, supporting our Mission, Principles of Service, and Core Values is a fundamental part of this job. Our foundational belief is the sacred value of human life.   • Coordinate with Development, Design, Construction and Finance teams to gather and distribute project information.
  • Facilitate meeting preparation, agendas and follow-up action tracking.
  • Maintain standardized templates, workflows and reporting tools developed by the Senior Manager.
  • Maintain the implementation and ongoing use of standard operating procedures (SOPs) for post-entitlement and permitting activities, including maintaining templates, checklists and documentation.
  • Identify gaps, inconsistencies or risks in tracking and documentation and escalate as appropriate.
  • Travel to project sites, City/County staff or planning meetings, as needed (up to 25%).

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Risk Identification and Mitigation Awareness
  • Time Management and Prioritization
  • Professional Judgment and Accountability
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Analytical thinking and data accuracy
  • Clear written and verbal communication
  • Collaboration and teamwork

Experience and Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed throughout this job description are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; concentration in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, Real Estate, Urban Planning, Business/finance or a related field preferred
  • Three (3) or more years of experience in real estate development, construction, planning, permitting, project coordination, development analytics or a related field
  • Experience with entitlement, permitting or development approval processes preferred
  • Proficiency in Smartsheet, Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office Suite
  • Experience working with shared document management systems (e.g., SharePoint); familiarity with project or construction management platforms (e.g., Procore) a plus
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively with internal teams, consultants and external agencies

68,600.00 - 85,750.00

description:

The role also covers accounts payables, bank liaising, bank guarantees, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations.

Invoice Scrutiny & Preparation:

- Ensure correctness of tax components including GST, TDS (India), and applicable Qatar requirements.
- Maintain invoice registers, revisions, credit notes, and supporting documentation.

Client Follow-ups & Payment Coordination:
- Coordinate with clients’ finance and accounts teams for invoice submission and acknowledgements.
- Follow up on outstanding invoices to ensure timely collections.
- Track accounts receivable aging and prepare collection status reports.

and Performance Bonds.

and other applicable laws.

Reporting & Documentation:

- Support internal and external audits by providing required data and clarifications.

General Responsibilities:
- Ensure confidentiality and integrity of financial data.
- Follow company financial policies, SOPs, and internal controls.
- Coordinate effectively with India and Qatar teams.

Qualifications:

title: General Operator
description:
The General Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient monitoring of oil and gas production processes. This is an entry-to-mid-level operations role focused on "hands-on" plant work, including starting and stopping equipment, opening and closing valves, taking samples, and assisting with minor maintenance. The goal is to ensure continuous production flow while adhering to strict safety and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities
1. Production Operations

Safely start up, operate, and shut down production equipment such as separators, compressors, pumps, and heaters.

Monitor gauges, meters, and control panels (DCS/SCADA) to ensure pressure, temperature, and flow rates are within operating limits.

Open and close manual valves to direct product flow through pipelines and processing units.

Perform routine line walks and visual inspections of the facility to detect leaks, vibrations, or abnormal conditions.

2. Sample Collection & Testing

Collect fluid samples (crude oil, condensate, produced water) at designated intervals.

Conduct basic quality control tests (e.g., BS&W – Basic Sediment & Water) to ensure product quality meets specifications.

Add chemicals (corrosion inhibitors, methanol, demulsifiers) to the process as directed.

3. Maintenance Support

Assist technicians with isolations for maintenance (fitting blinds, draining lines).

Perform basic preventive maintenance tasks such as greasing bearings, lubricating moving parts, and replacing filters.

Clean and maintain work areas, including spill cleanup and pressure washing decks.

4. Safety & Environmental Compliance

Strictly adhere to the Permit to Work (PTW) system and isolation standards (Lock-Out/Tag-Out).

Respond to emergency alarms and participate in regular safety drills (fire, H2S release, man overboard).

Report any near misses, unsafe acts, or environmental concerns immediately.

Ensure proper handling and disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste.

Qualifications & Requirements
Education & Certification

High School Diploma or equivalent.

H2S Alive certification is mandatory.

Standard First Aid & CPR.

WHMIS 2015 (GHS) or equivalent chemical safety training.

BOSIET / HUET / Offshore Medical required for offshore positions.

A valid Driver's License is typically required for onshore field positions.

Experience

0–3 years of experience in an industrial environment (entry-level candidates with the right safety tickets are often considered).

Previous experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, or Water Treatment is a strong advantage.

Experience working in a control room/field operations interface is a plus.

Technical Skills

Basic understanding of Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) and line walks.

Mechanical aptitude and comfort using hand tools.

Basic computer literacy for data entry and logbook maintenance.

Key Competencies
Alertness: Ability to maintain focus during repetitive tasks and long shifts.

Communication: Clear and concise reporting to the Control Room Operator (CRO) and supervisors.

Team Player: Willingness to assist colleagues during heavy workloads or emergencies.

Adaptability: Ability to work 12-hour rotating shifts (days/nights) in remote locations.

description:

title: Revenue Specialist, RMCC APAC
description:
This role will be based in our Revenue Management Consolidated Center - Asia Pacific (RMCC APAC) in Shanghai, China.

The Revenue Specialist, RMCC APAC maximizes revenue, market share and profits for multiple hotels through the strategic coordination of revenue management processes and procedures. This role will also support and execute projects that drive revenue, efficiency and operational excellence. You will also work with stakeholders from across the organization to ensure the successful delivery of project goals.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

  • Execute hands-on implementation of projects that drive revenue, efficiency, and operational excellence.

  • Set and monitor success metrics to track impact, efficiency gains, and operation improvements in real time.

  • Identify underperforming areas, troubleshoot root causes, and implement fixes without delay.

  • Meet deadlines without compromising quality and collaborate with teams to unlock progress and keep projects on track.

  • Ensure that sales and pricing strategies are based on sound commercial judgement through effective analysis and reporting.

  • Ensure professional and efficient utilization of all systems, in line with the company best practices and standard operating procedures.

  • Ensure effective information gathering and analysis are conducted to identify and maximize opportunities and minimize any risks.

  • Ensure that relevant hotel and above-hotel commercial team members are actively engaged in revenue decisions by maintaining regular communication to effectively implement, drive and review optimal strategies and controls.

  • Integrate with other functions to ensure we exceed customers’, owners’ and shareholders’ expectations.

Project Execution

  • Ensure project is delivered with the utmost efficiency, attention to details and operational excellence.

  • Execute and maintain a standardized project workflow.

  • Monitor project timelines, risks, and deliverables to ensure on-time completion.

  • Support to prepare the project training plan, including (and not limited to) hotel facing training documentation, and internal process related training.

  • Leverage automation tools and solutions to improve the working efficiency.

  • Support projects focused on revenue growth and sales process optimization.

  • Retain flexibility to ensure optimal project delivery.

Revenue Management

Inventory & Pricing:

  • Proactively review and implement room accommodation and rate inventory controls via IDeaS V5i and R&I daily.

  • Ensure group inventory and blackout dates align with demand and contracts.

  • Maintain rate parity across all distribution channels.

Strategy & Analysis:

  • Develop and refine pricing strategies based on market trends and competitive analysis.

  • Conduct weekly business reviews to evaluate performance and adjust tactics.

  • Analyze data to identify revenue opportunities and risks.

  • Maintain regular communication with commercial teams to align on revenue strategies.

Forecasting & Reporting:

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly forecasts and budgets using appropriate systems and tools.

  • Perform IDeaS V5i forecast validation process on a regular basis to identify changes in trends and opportunities to enhance IDeaS forecasts.

Driving Commercial Performance:

  • Drive incremental EBITDA, RevPar and Fair Market Share performance.

  • Responsible for delivering KPIs and performance with focus (and not limited to) room type supplements, peak nights, house overbooking and forecast accuracy.

  • Ensure any holiday cover commitments are managed as per standards.

WHY YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT

You have these minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher.

  • Practical experience in hotel revenue management, asset management, or feasibility.

  • Hands-on project execution and solid knowledge of project management frameworks.

  • Strong interpersonal skills to engage with relevant stakeholders in global, regional and hotel teams.

  • Able to set and maintain minimum standards.

  • Able to analyze data and identify significant trends.

  • Self-motivated and competitive.

  • Able to work accurately and effectively under pressure.

  • Good personal presentation.

  • Warm personality and possess team spirit.

  • Clear verbal/written English proficiency for cross-functional and regional collaboration.

  • Proactive: Identify underperforming areas and implements fixes swiftly.

  • Detail-Oriented: Ensure accuracy in data, reporting, and compliance (e.g., rate parity, system configurations).

  • Team-Focused: Collaborative spirit to align strategies with commercial teams and exceed KPIs (RevPAR, EBITDA).

The bill requires the Agency for Health Care Administration (AHCA), in consultation with all specified agencies, to develop and maintain a user-friendly, public-facing webpage to serve as a centralized hub for education and awareness of the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse and state background screening processes and standards. title: DJBOSS: Emergency Vehicle Technician II (EVT II)
description:
Title:

DJBOSS: Emergency Vehicle Technician II (EVT II)

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR!

Program Summary
KBR sustains the operational well-being of U.S. armed forces at Djibouti, Africa, Camp Lemonnier Naval Base. Our services encompass program management, contingency and expeditionary, asset management and recreation support, postal operations, safety services, logistics, and more. KBR ensures the base operate smoothly, allowing deployed personnel to focus on mission execution.
Job Summary
The Emergency Vehicle Technician II (EVT II) is responsible for inspecting, diagnosing, maintaining, testing, certifying, and repairing emergency response vehicles including fire apparatus, ambulances, fuel trucks, and associated equipment. The EVT II ensures vehicles remain mission-capable and compliant with NFPA standards, NAVFAC requirements, manufacturer specifications, and contract performance requirements.
Roles and Responsibilities

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on emergency vehicles and equipment.
• Diagnose and repair mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, electrical, and electronic systems.
• Maintain and repair diesel and gasoline engines, transmissions, drivetrains, steering, suspension, and brake systems.
• Inspect, maintain, and repair fire apparatus, ambulances, and fuel trucks.
• Perform troubleshooting using OEM diagnostic software and technical manuals.
• Conduct vehicle inspections and assist with required testing and certification activities.
• Complete field service calls and emergency repairs.
• Document maintenance actions, inspections, repairs, labor, and parts usage in NAVFAC MAXIMO TR.
• Identify warranty items, recalls, and recurring equipment deficiencies.
• Support vehicle readiness and downtime requirements in accordance with contract standards.
• Perform all work in accordance with NFPA 1071, NFPA 1911, NAVFAC P-300, NAVFAC P-307, OEM guidance, and applicable safety requirements.

Basic Qualifications
• High school diploma or equivalent.
• Certified Emergency Vehicle Technician II (EVT II).
**Level II certification required for both Fire Apparatus and Ambulance**
• Meets NFPA 1071 Emergency Vehicle Technician qualification requirements.
• Minimum three (3) years of emergency vehicle, fire apparatus, ambulance, heavy-truck, or military vehicle
maintenance experience.
• Valid driver's license.
• Ability to obtain and maintain installation access.

Preferred Qualifications
• Fire apparatus maintenance experience.
• Ambulance maintenance experience.
• EVT Commission certifications.
• ASE certifications.
• CDL or equivalent commercial vehicle qualification.
• Military or overseas contingency operations experience.
• Experience using Maximo or similar maintenance management systems.

Work Environment
• Outdoor and indoor maintenance operations in a high-temperature environment.
• Emergency and after-hours response may be required.
• Frequent lifting, climbing, kneeling, crawling, and working beneath vehicles.
• Must wear required personal protective equipment.

KBR Benefits
KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which include medical insurance. We support career advancement through professional training and development and flexible work schedule.

title: Loss Prevention Engineer
description:
• Conduct field inspections and audits of KAHRAMAA facilities, substations, workshops, warehouses, and project sites to ensure compliance with fire safety and loss prevention standards.

  • Review and verify life safety designs for new and existing facilities in line with KAHRAMAA, QCDD, and NFPA requirements.

  • Review and approve drawings, test reports, method statements, and material submittals related to loss prevention systems.

  • Supervise and monitor site activities, pre-commissioning, and testing of loss prevention systems, ensuring all works comply with KAHRAMAA HSE specifications.

  • Evaluate and approve materials and equipment used for fire detection, suppression, and smoke management systems to confirm compliance with international standards.

  • Coordinate with consultants, contractors, and internal departments on all loss prevention and fire safety-related activities.

  • Review and comment on As-built drawings, O&M manuals, and other technical documentation.

  • Apply in-depth understanding of fire protection system design, fire dynamics, and risk analysis techniques (qualitative and quantitative) in project evaluations.

  • Ensure compliance with QCDD regulations, NFPA Codes & Standards, and act as an active NFPA member.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of fire safety procedures, evacuation planning, and means of egress design.

  • Prepare technical reports and recommendations for corrective and preventive measures.

  • Demonstrate strong communication, teamwork, and leadership skills with a proactive approach to safety management.



Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, or Loss Prevention Engineering from a recognized university.

  • Experience: Minimum of 10 years in loss prevention engineering, preferably within the utilities (power and water) sector.

  • Proven background in design, inspection, erection, and commissioning of loss prevention systems and conducting fire risk assessments.

  • Certification: Certified Fire Protection Specialist (CFPS) from NFPA (mandatory).

  • Language Skills: Fluent in English (spoken & written); Arabic knowledge is an advantage.

  • Technical Skills: Proficient in MS Office, report writing, and presentation skills.

  • Must be available for mobile communication during and outside office hours for emergency contact.

  • Must pass written assessment and interview conducted by KAHRAMAA.

  • Valid Qatar Driving License required.

title: Road Foreman
description:
We are looking for an experienced Road Foreman to supervise road construction and maintenance activities at site. The candidate will be responsible for managing manpower, equipment, materials, and daily site activities while ensuring work is completed safely, on time, and as per project specifications.

​

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise road construction, excavation, grading, backfilling, compaction, asphalt, and reinstatement works.
  • Allocate daily tasks to workers, operators, and subcontractors.
  • Ensure work is carried out as per approved drawings, method statements, and project specifications.
  • Monitor site progress and report daily work status to the site engineer or supervisor.
  • Coordinate with site engineers, surveyors, QA/QC, HSE, and other construction teams.
  • Ensure proper use of materials, tools, machinery, and equipment at site.
  • Check levels, alignment, road layers, compaction, and surface preparation before further work.
  • Maintain safety standards and ensure workers follow PPE and HSE requirements.
  • Conduct toolbox talks and ensure good housekeeping at the worksite.
  • Support inspection activities and resolve minor site issues during execution.


Requirements

  • Relevant experience as Road Foreman in road works, infrastructure, or civil construction projects.
  • Good knowledge of road construction methods, asphalt works, subgrade, sub-base, base course, and compaction.
  • Ability to read basic drawings and follow site instructions.
  • Strong manpower handling and site coordination skills.
  • Knowledge of HSE procedures and safe work practices.
  • Locally available candidates with immediate joining will be preferred.
