title: Fuel Supply Scheduler
description:
Title:

Fuel Supply Scheduler

At KBR, We Deliver.

KBR ISA (Integrated Solutions Americas) delivers integrated, end-to-end engineering, procurement, and construction management services to the refining, LNG, midstream, chemicals, petrochemicals, oil and gas, power, and industrial infrastructure sectors. Our focus spans proprietary technology, consulting, and energy transition to complete delivery of major capital projects and programs.

KBR is seeking a Fuel Supply Scheduler to join the Project Controls team.

The Fuel Supply Scheduler is responsible for coordinating the timely and efficient movement of crude oil, NGLs, refined products, and other bulk liquid commodities across a multi-modal transportation network. This role serves as the operational link between commercial commitments and physical execution, ensuring product movements are scheduled, monitored, and completed safely, accurately, and in compliance with applicable procedures and transportation requirements.

The position requires close collaboration with operations, terminals, carriers, pipelines, and commercial stakeholders to support inventory management, supply continuity, and the resolution of day-to-day scheduling challenges.

This will be a project hire with an expected duration of 12 – 18 months.

Functional job responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

Supply & Transportation Coordination

  • Develop, execute, and maintain transportation schedules supporting crude oil, NGL, refined products, and other bulk liquid movements.

  • Coordinate product transfers across pipelines, terminals, storage facilities, marine assets, rail networks, and truck transportation providers.

  • Manage pipeline nomination activities, monitor scheduling cycles, and ensure submissions are completed within established timelines.

  • Monitor transportation constraints, allocations, maintenance activities, and operating limitations that may impact product delivery commitments.

  • Ensure operational schedules remain aligned with inventory requirements, customer commitments, and commercial objectives.

Inventory & Operational Monitoring

  • Track inventory balances and product positions across terminals, tanks, storage assets, and transportation systems.

  • Reconcile planned versus actual movements and investigate discrepancies involving volumes, timing, measurement, or location data.

  • Support inventory balancing and stock management efforts to maintain operational reliability and avoid supply disruptions.

  • Assist with month-end close activities, inventory validation, and movement actualization processes.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as a primary point of coordination between commercial teams, operations personnel, terminal operators, transportation providers, and supply organizations.

  • Communicate scheduling updates, transportation issues, inventory concerns, and emerging risks in a timely manner.

  • Work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders to resolve execution issues and optimize movement performance.

  • Escalate significant operational risks, transportation disruptions, or unresolved scheduling conflicts as appropriate.

Operational Excellence & Issue Resolution

  • Respond to changing operating conditions, including transportation delays, terminal constraints, supply interruptions, and weather-related impacts.

  • Support contingency planning and execution to minimize impacts to customer commitments and business operations.

  • Identify recurring operational challenges and recommend improvements to scheduling practices, workflows, and execution processes.

  • Contribute to cross-training, workload balancing, and knowledge-sharing initiatives within the scheduling organization.

Compliance & Controls

  • Execute activities in accordance with company procedures, transportation agreements, regulatory requirements, and internal controls.

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and auditable records of nominations, schedule changes, inventory transactions, and movement documentation.

  • Promote safe work practices and sound operational decision-making in all transportation and scheduling activities.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable tariff requirements, transportation rules, and relevant industry regulations.

Required Education, Experience, & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business, Economics, or a related discipline; equivalent industry experience may be considered.

  • 3-5 years of experience supporting scheduling, logistics, transportation operations, inventory management, supply coordination, or related functions within the energy, refining, petrochemical, midstream, or industrial sectors.

  • Working knowledge of bulk liquid transportation and supply chain operations.

  • Experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced operational environment.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and standard business applications.

Preferred Education & Skills:

  • Experience supporting crude oil, NGL, refined products, fuels, ethanol, petrochemical, or chemical supply chains.

  • Familiarity with pipeline nomination processes, terminal operations, and transportation scheduling platforms.

  • Experience with CTRM/ETRM systems such as RightAngle, Endur, Allegro, Quorum, SAP TSW, or similar applications.

  • Understanding of pipeline tariffs, transportation contracts, inventory management practices, and supply optimization principles.

  • Experience working with commercial, trading, refining, or supply optimization organizations.

KBR Benefits​

KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.​

title: Material Engineer
description:
​

The Material Engineer is responsible for the selection, testing, inspection, and approval of construction materials to ensure compliance with project specifications, standards, and quality requirements. The role supports engineering and site teams by ensuring materials used meet technical, safety, and durability standards throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review, evaluate, and approve material submittals in line with project specifications and standards.

  • Conduct material inspections, testing, and quality checks at site, plant, or laboratory.

  • Coordinate with QA/QC, consultants, suppliers, and site teams for material approvals and compliance.

  • Ensure materials conform to relevant international standards (ASTM, BS, AASHTO, ISO, etc.).

  • Monitor storage, handling, and usage of materials to prevent damage or quality issues.

  • Investigate material-related non-conformances and support corrective and preventive actions.

  • Maintain records of material approvals, test reports, and inspection documentation.

  • Support audits, inspections, and technical reviews related to materials engineering.

​

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Material Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum 3–7 years of experience as a Material Engineer in construction or infrastructure projects.

  • Strong knowledge of construction materials (concrete, asphalt, steel, aggregates, soils, etc.).

  • Hands-on experience with material testing, inspection, and quality assurance processes.

  • Familiarity with international material standards and project specifications.

  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and test results.

  • Strong coordination, reporting, and documentation skills.

  • Good communication skills and ability to work with multidisciplinary teams.

title: Security Team Leader (Hilton Singapore Orchard)
description:
Position Summary

The Security Team Leader assists the Security Executive in guiding the Security Officers on duty to ensure that hotel work procedures and inspection work is carried out correctly. The role should cover the daily work of the Security Executive in his / her absence.

What will I be doing?

As the Security Team Leader, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Supervise each security operation shift, making sure adequate patrol patterns and frequencies are maintained to ensure the security of guests and team members.

  • Familiarize with and check hotel fire equipment and fire evacuation passages.

  • Ensure Security Officers report issues to respective department promptly as recorded during their patrols.

  • Familiarize with each department’s work procedures, security knowledge and emergency procedures, supervising each position’s professional knowledge and work standard.

  • Conduct random bag inspections of team members entering and leaving the building.

  • Ensure asset removal policy is adhered to, to prevent hotel assets from being removed without proper authorization.

  • Arrange escort services for team members carrying cash, where required.

  • Maintain perimeter patrols at points of entry and egress to ensure that there are no loiterers in the hotel premise.

  • Professionally examine team members’ work knowledge, discipline and responsibilities.

  • Conduct random inspections of the hotel to ensure security practices are being followed, fire exits are not blocked, and equipment is not obstructing fire hose reel doors, sufficient clearance between stacked goods and sprinkler heads.

  • Take appropriate action to resolve guests’ complaints, communicating professionally and effectively with guests.

  • Be familiar with current first aid and fire emergency procedures.

  • Ensure a high level of cleanliness and tidiness in work area.

  • Maintain a professional appearance up to Hilton standards, demonstrating good attitude and behaviour at all times.

  • Interact with team members in a professional and positive manner to foster good rapport, promote team spirit and ensure effective two-way communication.

  • Adhere to the hotel’s policies and procedures, Hilton code of conduct and the hotel’s team member handbook.

  • Carry out other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.

What are we looking for?

A Security Team Leader serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • High School or Secondary Vocational School graduate.

  • Holds a valid Security Officer License by Police Licensing and Regulatory Department (PLRD).

title: Data Warehouse Expert
description:
Job Title: Data Warehouse Expert

Engagement Type: Consultant – Project Management & Consulting (PMC) and Technical Support
Project Phase: Phase 3 – Implementation, PMC, and Technical Support
Reporting To: Project Director / Client Representative

Job Summary

The Data Warehouse Expert will provide specialized consulting, technical oversight, and project management support during Phase 3 of the project. The role is responsible for overseeing the implementation, integration, and optimization of the Data Warehouse solution, ensuring alignment with approved architecture, data governance standards, performance requirements, and project timelines through to the issuance of the Final Acceptance Certificate (FAC).

The consultant will work closely with system integrators, data engineers, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure the Data Warehouse solution is delivered, validated, and fully operational.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Oversight

  • Monitor and oversee Data Warehouse implementation activities to ensure adherence to the approved project plan, scope, timelines, and milestones.

  • Support the client in tracking progress, risks, issues, and dependencies related to data platforms and analytics deliverables.

  • Ensure compliance with contractual, architectural, and data governance requirements.

Data Warehouse Architecture & Implementation

  • Provide expert guidance on Data Warehouse architecture, data models, ETL/ELT pipelines, and integration approaches.

  • Review and validate logical and physical data models, data integration designs, and implementation documents.

  • Ensure scalability, performance, security, and reliability of the Data Warehouse solution.

Data Integration & Quality

  • Oversee integration of data from multiple source systems, including transactional systems, applications, and third-party platforms.

  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and timeliness across the Data Warehouse.

  • Support the definition and enforcement of data quality, metadata management, and master data standards.

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Facilitate coordination between system integrators, data engineers, BI/analytics teams, and business stakeholders.

  • Participate in project meetings, design reviews, technical workshops, and status reporting.

  • Act as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor to the client on Data Warehouse–related matters.

Testing, Validation & Performance

  • Support and oversee data validation, reconciliation, and testing activities.

  • Review results of system testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT).

  • Ensure performance tuning, optimization, and issue resolution during implementation.

Technical Support & Issue Resolution

  • Identify, analyze, and resolve technical or operational challenges related to data ingestion, transformation, storage, and reporting.

  • Provide hands-on technical support in specialized data domains as required during the implementation phase.
